title.narrative: [Resource] UK-Africa Science Partnership CORE fund - promoting research and innovation collaboration to address joint priorities

description.narrative:
Supporting the creation of a Strategic Science Diplomacy Platform to promote engagement and collaboration between UK missions and African governments on science, technology, and innovation. The platform will support cross-HMG efforts to deepen UK relationships with African governments on joint research and innovation priorities, by convening and developing partnerships to access a wide range of stakeholders in country. The platform will be able to leverage co-investment from other donors/funders, led by the FCDO regional RED Hubs across Africa. The ODA and non-ODA R&D landscape is evolving therefore this platform is essential if FCDO is to be able to be responsive to a changing environment and work with our partner countries in a timely and productive manner.
The convening will include government-to-government mechanisms such as High-Level Oversight Boards on Science, Technology and Innovation in Kenya, and partnerships between researchers, private sector, and government agencies. Other proposed activity under this workstream includes: 1) Support the development of bi-lateral science partnership between the UK and partner countries via their SCGs and develop shared priorities for collaboration and learning for development impact and diplomatic influence, for example through facilitating meetings and supporting dialogue of relevant stakeholders.
2) Workshops on science and technology topics, co-created by partner governments, SGCs and FCDO Country Offices, that provide opportunities to showcase UK expertise and convene a diverse set of stakeholders, including those not previously engaged in research and innovation.
3) Technical assistance to partner governments to strengthen funding and regulatory environments to promote the development and distribution of new technologies and scientific discovery.
